summary: 520 Illinois Street (per Commercial Property Executive), a five-story, ~182,800-sq-ft clinical building (Stantec design, Clark Construction general contractor) on UCSF's Block 34, at the corner of 3rd and Mariposa Streets -- Pier & Point identifies this as the north portion of what it had tracked as one combined "block 34" area, split 2026-09-22 along a visible roofline seam from the Illinois Street Garage immediately south of it; per SF YIMBY the clinical building and the garage are both part of UCSF's development of Block 34.

milestones.text: UC Regents' Finance and Capital Strategies Committee's May 19, 2020 open-session agenda lists for action preliminary-plans and working-drawings funding and scope for the Block 34 parking garage and preliminary-plans funding for the Block 34 clinical building; the outcome is not shown by a source read
Construction of the Block 34 clinical building begins: Clark announces on September 23, 2021 that it has broken ground (SF YIMBY reported on October 2, 2021 that crews had started)
UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building (520 Illinois St) opens

costs.what: "The project's development costs amounted to $228 million," per Commercial Property Executive's coverage of the Bayfront Medical Building's opening (which attributes it to the San Francisco Chronicle); the article does not say whether the figure includes the adjoining nine-level, 500-space Illinois Street Garage it describes in the same piece

open_questions: 2026-09-22, corroborating data point: DataSF business registrations whose point-location falls inside this record's shape list '520 Illinois St # D2317' and '520 Illinois St # D1200' as their address -- matching the 520 Illinois St address already sourced from UCSF Real Estate's own project page, not contradicting it. That match is by location only and was not individually confirmed, so this is logged as corroboration, not an independent primary source.

SPLIT 2026-09-22: this record was previously a single OCII plan block 34 record (a probable, geographically-inferred identity for the WHOLE of a mapped area that also included the Illinois Street Garage to its south). This was corrected: UCSF built three real structures where the OCII plan showed two, and Bayfront Medical Building is only the north piece of that area (the Illinois Street Garage record covers the south piece). The split follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line, and its exact boundary should be treated as indicative rather than authoritative.

Total project cost is reported elsewhere as approximately $335.8 million for the combined clinical building and garage; not broken out per building and not independently verified against a primary UCSF or Regents document, so left out of costs.

As of 2026-09-29, UCSF Real Estate's project page and Stantec's news page could not be read; the address (520 Illinois St), story count, size, architect, contractor and opening date are now backed by Commercial Property Executive, SF YIMBY and Clark's release. The Regents outcome for the May 2020 Block 34 items was not found (only the committee agenda was read). The construction start is Clark's September 2021 groundbreaking announcement; CPE and Clark say the garage began earlier (April 2021). The 590 Illinois St address given for the Illinois Street Garage is not in any source that could be read. Whether CPE's $228 million includes the garage is not stated.
